disposition_reason: Table 1 prints max, min and mean (dry weight) of Cr, Mn, Ni, Cu, As, Cd and Pb in grape skins and pulps for Chinese market, e-waste-area, courtyard and Chilean grapes.

study.design: Nationwide pilot survey of grapes (41 samples: 29 market, 7 e-waste dismantling area, 4 courtyard, 1 Chile), skins and pulps analysed separately; 6 paired washed/unwashed aliquots
study.origin: 11 provinces of China (market grapes locally grown); one sample from Chile
study.market: local markets; e-waste dismantling area in Taizhou; home courtyards
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7500) after HNO3/H2O2 microwave digestion of 0.2 g lyophilized tissue
study.qa: SRMs peach leaves GBW08501 and tea leaves GBW08513; recoveries Cu 79.0-83.4, Mn 96.8-102, Cr 81.2-89.4, Ni 79.9-85.7, As 97.0-119%, Pb 70.2 ± 5.1%; blanks below detection

controls.comparator: 6 paired unwashed vs washed skin aliquots
controls.outcome: 4.12-72.3% of skin Cu removed (average 7.62%); 25.4% (PS20/PS23) and 72.3% (PS38/PS39) for two e-waste-area samples; significant (p < 0.05)
Pb in unwashed skins 3.0 times washed skins (66.7% removed); p = 0.06

controls.comparator: grape skins vs pulps, Wilcoxon test
controls.outcome: skin/pulp geometric mean ratios Cr 2.15, Mn 3.25, Ni 4.58, As 1.01; Cr, Mn, Ni, Cu significantly higher in skins (p < 0.05); As not different; Pb detected in 95.7% of skins vs 2.44% of pulps

controls.control: growing site (market vs e-waste area vs courtyard)
controls.outcome: no significant difference in Cu; Cr, Ni, As, Cd, Pb in e-waste-area grapes 'very close' to market and courtyard grapes

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Chinese national tolerance limit for copper in fruit

unresolved: LOD values not reported; N.D. cells unquantified.
Market skin Mn maximum of 2013 μg/g dw looks like a misprint but cannot be checked.
Abstract Cu means (skin 5.02 ± 3.18, pulp 3.74 ± 1.48 μg/g) differ from Results/Table 1 (5.22 and 3.73/3.75).
Moisture contents (skins 74.2-88.9%, pulps 78.4-92.3%) are printed but per-sample fresh-weight values are not; no fresh-weight conversion made.
